answer.label: Not Bradbury — Juan Ramón Jiménez
answer.sourceLine: Wikiquote identifies the line in Fahrenheit 451 as an epigraph translating Juan Ramón Jiménez. Bradbury’s use of a quotation is not authorship; the translator of this English wording was not established here.
